title: U.S. House · North Carolina's 4th District
area: Orange, Durham and Chatham counties, including Chapel Hill and Durham.

context.text: Incumbent Valerie Foushee (D) won her Democratic primary and faces Mahesh Ganorkar (R) and Guy Meilleur (L), both of whom advanced from canceled Republican and Libertarian primaries respectively, in the general election.

candidates.name: Valerie Foushee

priorities.text: Delivering relief to working families facing higher costs, including offsetting the impact of tariffs on everyday expenses.
Government oversight and accountability, including of U.S. military assistance abroad and immigration enforcement agencies.

positions.summary: In a September 2026 press release, introduced the American Tariff Rebate Act for tax rebates to offset tariff costs and called the administration's tariffs "reckless."
positions.quote: The American Tariff Rebate Act puts money directly back into the pockets of middle-class families by providing swift, direct tax rebates to offset the costs associated with the President's tariffs and the rising cost of everyday expenses.

positions.summary: In a July 2026 press release, said she voted for an amendment to restrict U.S. military assistance to Israel because Congress must exercise oversight over that assistance.
positions.quote: Today, I supported Congressman Massie's amendment because Congress must exercise its oversight role and ensure accountability in how U.S. military assistance is provided.

positions.summary: Her campaign issues page says she is working to limit ICE's authority, ban masks for ICE agents and require body cameras.
positions.quote: In Congress, she is working to limit ICE’s authority and mandate, ban ICE agents from wearing masks, require that they wear body cameras, and crack down on agents who abuse their power or violate people’s rights.

positions.summary: Her campaign issues page describes healthcare as a universal right and says she supports extending the Affordable Care Act subsidies and Medicare for All.
positions.quote: She strongly supports extending the Affordable Care Act subsidies to ensure that millions of Americans are able to maintain their healthcare.

positions.summary: Her campaign issues page says she is working to pass legislation to codify Roe v. Wade and to protect access to contraceptives.
positions.quote: In Congress, she is working to pass legislation to codify Roe so state legislatures are no longer able to pass restrictive and archaic abortion laws and legislation to protect access to contraceptives.

positions.summary: Her campaign issues page says she supports raising the corporate tax rate, higher capital gains taxes and a 25% minimum tax on households with a net worth over $100 million.
positions.quote: Foushee supports a progressive tax system that provides relief for middle and low-income families while increasing taxes on large corporations and high-income earners.

positions.summary: Her campaign issues page says she supports the Green New Deal and a transition to a clean energy economy.
positions.quote: Foushee is a strong supporter of the Green New Deal and believes that we need to make bold steps to tackle climate change and transition to a clean energy economy.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure (Highways and Transit; Railroads, Pipelines, and Hazardous Materials subcommittees) and the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, where she was ranking member of the Investigations and Oversight subcommittee in the 118th Congress.
Introduced the American Tariff Rebate Act, which would provide direct tax rebates to offset the cost of tariffs for middle-class families.

candidates.researchNotes: Federal key votes and FEC totals for this sitting member of Congress are added separately. Committee assignments reflect the most recent listing found (118th Congress, 2023-2024); an updated 2025-2026 assignment list was not confirmed within the research budget. Positions are drawn from her official House press releases; her sponsored-legislation list and other press releases (ICE detention center oversight, prison commissary pricing, medical waste, grad student housing) were also checked but did not squarely match an ISSUES statement.

candidates.name: Mahesh Ganorkar
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced from a canceled Republican primary.

priorities.text: Repealing the Sixteenth Amendment and giving taxpayers more direct control over federal spending approvals through their tax filings.
Election security measures including mandatory voter ID, paper ballots, and eliminating mail-in and absentee voting.
Opposing illegal immigration, including mandatory E-Verify and ending birthright citizenship for children of people in the country illegally.

positions.summary: Says he supports expanding school choice, including funding students directly through school vouchers applied through parents' tax returns.
positions.quote: I believe expanding school choice and privatizing education would create more opportunities for students

positions.summary: Says tariffs function as taxes on consumers and that excessive tariffs often raise costs.
positions.quote: Common sense tells us that excessive tariffs and protectionism often raise costs for consumers and small businesses the most.

positions.summary: Supports Constitutional Carry nationwide and says law-abiding citizens should be able to protect themselves without unnecessary restrictions.
positions.quote: Constitutional Carry from sea to shining sea

positions.summary: Says he does not personally support abortion but that in cases of rape, incest, or risk to the mother's life the decision should remain within the family, guided by medical professionals.
positions.quote: My faith discourages abortion, and personally I do not support it; however, in tragic cases such as rape, incest, or when a mother’s life is at risk, I believe these decisions should remain within the family, guided by medical professionals.

candidates.researchNotes: Positions and statements added from his campaign website issues page; the priorities come from the same website as quoted by Ballotpedia. He has not completed a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey. Nothing was found on rent regulation, minimum wage, police funding, or war powers.

statements.quote: If you believe our daughters and women deserve privacy, dignity, and safety in sports and private spaces, I’m your candidate.
Promote policies that increase housing supply and homeownership opportunities.
If you want immigration based on merit, the rule of law, and assimilation, I am your candidate.
My healthcare plan puts patients, not bureaucrats, in control by providing healthcare vouchers directly to citizens through the tax-filing process, ensuring the money is in the hands of the people.

candidates.name: Guy Meilleur
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced from a canceled Libertarian Party primary.

priorities.text: Says progress should be measured by freedom gained rather than dollars spent.
priorities.quote: Measuring progress by freedom gained, not dollars spent

priorities.text: Says countries should be equipped for self defense rather than attacking their neighbors.
priorities.quote: Equipping countries for self defense, NOT attacking their neighbors

priorities.text: Says people need the power to sue polluters.
priorities.quote: People need the power to sue polluters who poison our air and water.

positions.summary: His campaign website lists expanding and fully funding the North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship program and the state Education Savings Account program.
positions.quote: Expand and fully fund the North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship program, allowing greater access for all families, including those who lack the financial means to enroll their students in a private school.

positions.summary: His campaign website says to allow duplexes and triplexes by right where single-family homes are permitted.
positions.quote: Allow duplexes and triplexes by-right wherever single-family homes are permitted in low-density areas.

positions.summary: His campaign website says deploying US troops to combat overseas without a declaration of war by Congress is unconstitutional.
positions.quote: Deploying any US troops to combat overseas without a declaration of war by Congress is unconstitutional

candidates.researchNotes: Positions come from the priorities pages of his campaign website (guy4nc.org); several pages use North Carolina state-policy wording. He has not completed a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey. Nothing was found on abortion, guns, immigration, or tariffs.

statements.quote: Transition the current Medicaid direct payment model to a state-funded health savings account, giving people more flexibility in defining the healthcare options that best serve their individual circumstances.
Stabilize temperatures and weather through global and local collaborations.
statements.context: On his campaign website, among conservation policy proposals

statements.quote: Tel Aviv and Kyiv deserve Iron Domes, but we should stop supporting tyrants.
